title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 22, 2026, relative to California Assembly Bill 481
text:
[5. REGULAR AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated October 22, 2026, relative to California Assembly Bill 481
  Equipment Report, as set forth.  [BPC #26-331]

summary: The commission is asked to approve the department's Assembly Bill 481 equipment report and send it to City Council.

details.action: approve report and transmit to City Council
